newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Menem wants labor reform to apply to state workers.
newsitem.headline: Menem wants labor reform to apply to state workers.

text.p: Argentine President Carlos Menem has sent a bill to Congress in an attempt to extend to state employees labor reform plans which he is pushing for in the private sector, Clarin newspaper reported Monday.

The bill would introduce dramatic changes in employment terms for about 200,000 workers, by introducing trial periods and letting workers be transferred among ministries. But it does not include the security forces, for whom the government is analyzing a special regime, Clarin said.

Menem is trying to push labor reforms through parliament to fight 17.3 percent unemployment, which is shown by polls to be the top concern of most Argentines. The high jobless level and the planned labor reforms have been behind three general strikes this year, the most recent of which took place Thursday.
